_about: Current acceptance-check status (A1-A10) and known limitations. Rendered by tools/make_dashboard.py. AUDIT_BASELINE.md section 4 keeps the earlier baseline snapshot (pre-fix statuses) and docs/TRACEABILITY.md is an older table; this file supersedes both. Statuses: PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL, NOT YET TESTED. PASS requires evidence re-executed or a verifiable stored artifact; code existing is not a pass. Every claim here was checked by an independent claim audit (docs/claim_ledger.csv).

test_suite.text: Full suite including the 16 Docker-marked tests (13 scripted-candidate gate tests, 3 network/timeout tests): 249 passed in 815 s on 2026-11-09 (code fd1a403 plus documentation changes). Fast suite: 233 passed (docs/audit/reproduction_log.txt run).

acceptance_checks.name: One command full loop
acceptance_checks.criterion: One command completes detection, diagnosis, candidates, gates, decision and deployment on F01, F04 and F06, with every step artifact.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Full runs with provenance on 2026-11-08, all with outcome completed and every step artifact present: F06 f06-rule-scripted-20261108t173444z (code f5ef81a, clean tree), F01 f01-rule-scripted-20261108t174806z (f5ef81a plus an uncommitted docs-only change; same code hash as the F06 run), F04 f04-rule-scripted-20261108t175754z (f5ef81a plus uncommitted docs and provenance-fix changes, recorded in run.json). Repeated from committed code fd1a403: f06-rule-scripted-20261108t201808z, f04-rule-scripted-20261108t205508z. The baseline restore is printed to the terminal, not stored as an artifact.
acceptance_checks.limitation: Scripted runs as listed; live-AI end-to-end runs also completed on all three faults (f06-live-live-20261108t193456z, f01-live-live-20261108t195433z, f04-live-live-20261108t200721z).

acceptance_checks.name: Detection within 60 s
acceptance_checks.criterion: Incident raised within 60 s of injection; no incident during at least 5 min of healthy load.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Detection: from the faulty container first answering to the incident, 5 s (F06, probe_mismatch), 5 s (F01, probe_5xx) and 6 s (F04, health_down); from the start of the swap about 9, 8 and 10 s (swap_to_answer_s 4.2, 3.2, 4.3 in faulty_deploy.json; swap_started_at is stamped when the container first answers). All under 60 s. No false alarm: runs/healthy-watch-20261108t182609z ran the real detector for 300 s against the healthy baseline under 20 req/s load (about 6000 requests: 5408 x HTTP 200, 592 x HTTP 400 from customer-less searches); result no_incident (tools/healthy_watch.py).
acceptance_checks.limitation: The evidence quotes one detection per fault; other runs in runs/ show the same 5-7 s range. Timestamps have 1 s resolution. The healthy window used synthetic load on a laptop.

acceptance_checks.name: Diagnosis with at most 3 ranked causes
acceptance_checks.criterion: Valid diagnosis with at most 3 ranked causes and provider mode recorded; localisation measured on live runs.
acceptance_checks.evidence: At most 3 ranked causes, schema-enforced; provider mode recorded. Localisation counted once per diagnosis run (results/llm_diagnosis.csv): gpt-oss-120b F01 2/2, F06 2/2, F04 0/1; qwen 7b F01 2/2, F06 2/2, F04 0/2; qwen 1.5b F06 3/3.
acceptance_checks.limitation: Both models tried on F04 (gpt-oss-120b 0/1, qwen 7b 0/2; qwen 1.5b was not run on F04) miss its configuration root cause, even at top-3. Rule-mode diagnoses of F04 and F06 come from the fault definition (oracle localisation), are flagged and are not scored. Localisation scoring is not blinded. Small n.

acceptance_checks.name: Candidate generation or logged failure
acceptance_checks.criterion: Three candidates or a logged model failure, each applying cleanly or carrying its exact rejection reason.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Every LLM attempt (32) records whether it applied cleanly and, if not, the git apply error (full text in runs/*/patches.json; results/llm_units.csv keeps the first 80 characters). Failures that still produced a diff stay in the denominator. The 15 gpt-oss-120b attempts also record a raw-response hash, format status and normalizer rules. Runs that failed before producing candidates are listed in results/runs.csv.
acceptance_checks.limitation: One run, f06-live-live-20261108t051825z (made from uncommitted code, audit F-24), produced 2 candidates and logged no failure for the third. The 17 earlier qwen attempts predate the raw-hash and format-status fields. The two F-24 runs are flagged here and in AUDIT_BASELINE.md, not in the generated tables.

acceptance_checks.name: Isolated Docker sandbox
acceptance_checks.criterion: Sandbox runs with --network none and resource limits; an outbound request demonstrably fails; no secret, label or hidden-test mounts.
acceptance_checks.evidence: docs/audit/isolation_test.txt (2026-11-08, Docker 29.8.0): inside a sandbox container with --network none, DNS lookup -> UnknownHostException, TCP to 1.1.1.1:443 -> Network is unreachable, curl to Maven Central -> could not resolve host. Positive control: the same probe on Docker's bridge network reaches the internet, so the probe is able to detect access. Limits (--memory 2g, --cpus 2, --pids-limit 512, --cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, non-root) are set in sandbox_args; mount contents are tested to exclude hidden_tests and labels.
acceptance_checks.limitation: Resource limits are configured but not stress-tested. Hidden oracle tests exist (faults/*/hidden_tests/, gitignored). A unit test (test_sandbox.py, fake Docker, F06 correct candidate) checks that the files mounted for each gate include no hidden test or labels.json; sandbox trees are built only from app/, inject.diff, target_test/ and config/. The oracle runs hidden tests only outside the pipeline (tools/oracle.py).

acceptance_checks.name: V1, V2 and V3 each catch distinct bad changes
acceptance_checks.criterion: Across seeded candidates, V1, V2 and V3 each stop changes the others do not.
acceptance_checks.evidence: With oracle-v1 machine labels (results/gate_incremental.csv, scripted cohort; 16 hand-built patches x 2 diagnosis modes = 32 units): V1 first-stops 6 incorrect units (3 ineffective diffs), V2 6 regressive (+1 insecure via a tool error, counted separately), V3 5 insecure; 0 of 6 correct units stopped. All 16 Docker-marked tests passed in the 2026-11-09 full-suite run.
acceptance_checks.limitation: Labels are machine labels; two-person blind review pending. The hidden tests and security probe are independent of V1 and V3, but the 'regressive' label reuses the existing app suite that V2 runs. Overfitting and slow patches pass every gate.

acceptance_checks.name: Every decision branch tested; no error becomes a pass
acceptance_checks.criterion: Every decision branch and reason is tested; no error or timeout is treated as a pass.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Decision branches are unit-tested (test_decide.py). A real container that exceeded its timeout was killed, removed, and classified as 'timeout', not a pass (test_timeout_kills_and_removes_container, docs/audit/isolation_test.txt). A real Docker tool error on V2 is recorded as 'error' and the candidate rejected (f06-live-diag-4).
acceptance_checks.limitation: Decision branches were also exercised on 32 live-AI candidates (all three outcomes occur). The only real tool error was on one scripted candidate (f06-live-diag-4, V2). The timeout was shown with a synthetic container, not a candidate.

acceptance_checks.name: Human approval and auto-apply
acceptance_checks.criterion: Real human approval with human_cli provenance, a separate low-risk auto-apply, and real container deployments.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Human approve then deploy: F04 f04-rule-scripted-20261108t175754z, ESCALATE (sensitive path), approved at the terminal (approval_source human_cli, 18:06:57Z), deployed and promoted. Repeated on 2026-11-09: f04-rule-scripted-20261108t205508z, approved (human_cli), smoke-tested side by side, promoted with the image ID verified. The prompt refuses a malformed answer and asks again (unit test in tests/test_deploy.py; approval.json stores only the final answer). A separate AUTO_APPLY needing no prompt: F01 and F06 runs. An earlier human reject is also recorded (2026-11-07).
acceptance_checks.limitation: Two approvals and one rejection, all on the hand-built F04 config patch (F04-scripted-835a25e8); no AI-drafted patch has received a human decision. The decisions were made by two project members, not independent reviewers.

acceptance_checks.name: Promotion and automated rollback
acceptance_checks.criterion: A patched image is promoted on a healthy window; a staged latent regression triggers rollback to the previous image, verified by its local image ID (docker image inspect .Id). Revised from 'old image digest' in AUDIT_BASELINE.md: these local builds are never pushed, so no registry digest exists.
acceptance_checks.evidence: Rollback: f06-rule-scripted-20261108t201808z (code fd1a403, clean tree) deployed the planted slow candidate F06-scripted-7509cb64 (passed V0-V3). It first passed a side-by-side smoke test on port 18081 (11.5 s, health UP), then was cut over. In the health window, probe order2-discount-at-threshold took 3015 ms against a 2000 ms limit (window p95 3149.6 ms over 4 requests). It rolled back in 5.1 s to the previous image; restored_image_id sha256:3f32b4374203... equals the recorded previous_image_id and restored_image_verified is true (rollback.json). Promotion: the 4 promotions since the image-ID check was added record promoted_image_verified true (f06-live-live-20261108t193456z, f01-live-live-20261108t195433z, f04-live-live-20261108t200721z, f04-rule-scripted-20261108t205508z); the 6 earlier ones are by tag only. Example: f06-live-live-20261108t193456z, p95 5.3 ms over 44 requests. An earlier staged rollback (f06-rule-scripted-20261108t180955z, 4.0 s, tag only) is kept as history.
acceptance_checks.limitation: The rollback is staged (a planted slow patch), never counted as a real catch; no unplanned rollback has been observed. The breach was caught by the per-probe latency limit; p95 needs min_requests and the window was short. Laptop Docker, not a production canary.

acceptance_checks.name: Evidence regeneration
acceptance_checks.criterion: Analysis regenerates exact counts with hashes; raw rows reconcile; scripted and live are never conflated.
acceptance_checks.evidence: python analyse.py regenerates every table from results/evidence.jsonl, results/oracle_report.jsonl, faults/*/candidates/labels.json and the runs/ directories; --check verifies results/ is current; cohorts are never pooled; the run ledger (results/runs.csv) lists every run directory with its own row count next to its count in results/. reproduce.ps1 re-runs the fast tests, the analysis, the dashboard and the manifest and writes SHA-256 of every results/ table to docs/audit/reproduction_log.txt (run 2026-11-09 at code 57b422b; the oracle re-runs only with -Oracle).
acceptance_checks.limitation: One pre-S0 run, f06-rule-scripted-20261023t141305z, has 6 rows in its own folder that are not in results/ (audit F-12); it is shown in the ledger, not hidden. Independent rerun by a second team member pending.

known_limitations.title: Oracle labels not yet human-reviewed
known_limitations.description: tools/oracle.py labels every candidate (hidden tests, full suite, performance test, security probe). Two-person blind review (docs/label_adjudication.csv) is pending; no held-out faults yet.

known_limitations.title: Rule-mode diagnosis uses the answer key for F04 and F06
known_limitations.description: In rule mode, incidents without a stack trace (F04 health DOWN, F06 probe mismatch) take the diagnosed file from faults/<id>/fault.json. These diagnoses are flagged oracle_localisation=true and excluded from localisation hit rates, but the scripted F04/F06 rule-mode units feed the decision engine's file-scope rule with perfect localisation. Live-model diagnoses do not have this advantage (gpt-oss-120b missed F04).

known_limitations.title: AI patches can pass every gate and still be wrong
known_limitations.description: Under the full policy, 2 of 5 auto-applied gpt-oss-120b patches were labelled incorrect by the oracle: a null-only guard (F01) and a health indicator forced UP after a misdiagnosis (F04). The correct F04 config fix was escalated but never reached a human, because an AUTO_APPLY candidate existed.

known_limitations.title: A real AI repair works end to end
known_limitations.description: gpt-oss-120b diagnosed F06 and drafted a fix that passed V0-V3, was smoke-tested, deployed, promoted (image ID verified) and labelled correct by the oracle (f06-live-live-20261108t193456z).

known_limitations.title: Two live runs were produced by uncommitted code
known_limitations.description: f06-live-live-20261108t051825z and 052717z were made by a repair-loop version of providers.py that is in no commit. Their results cannot be reproduced from this repository. New runs record a code hash and git state (pipeline/provenance.py).

known_limitations.title: Replay not yet demonstrated
known_limitations.description: The only 3 replay attempts (f01, f04, f06; 2026-10-22, qwen2.5-coder:7b) stopped with a replay cache miss. Replay has not been retried since the versioned cache key (CACHE_KEY_VERSION = 2) or against the recorded gpt-oss-120b responses.

known_limitations.title: Rollback shown only as a staged demo
known_limitations.description: Two staged rollbacks with a planted slow patch; the latest (f06-rule-scripted-20261108t201808z) recovered in 5.1 s and verified the restored image by ID. Candidates are now smoke-tested side by side before cutover. No real (unplanned) rollback has been observed, and this is a laptop container swap, not a production canary.

known_limitations.title: Overfitting candidates pass every gate; the F06 one was auto-applied and promoted
known_limitations.description: The F06 overfitting candidate passed V0-V3, was auto-applied, passed the health window and was promoted in 3 runs (results/deployments.csv). In this pilot no gate or health window flagged any overfitting candidate; only the independent hidden-test oracle labelled them incorrect.

known_limitations.title: Infrastructure error recorded as error
known_limitations.description: In f06-live-diag-4, the F06 insecure candidate's V2 stopped with a Docker tool error. It is recorded as error (not as fail or pass) and the candidate was rejected.
